items.question: What is Bonfiire?
items.answer: Bonfiire is an app for organizing and joining events. Find things to do, invite your friends, and keep everything about an event in one place.

items.question: What kinds of events can I host?
items.answer: From a house party, a meetup or a game night, and or city hopping Appro, you can host any kind of events.

items.question: How do I find events?
items.answer: Move the map view on the home screen around to find events near you, or events in places you are going to visit.

items.question: How does check-in work?
items.answer: Every participant has an e-ticket with a QR code. The organizer scans it with the ticket scanner in the app when you arrive.

items.question: Can other people help me run my event?
items.answer: Yes. Add co-hosts to manage the event with you. For an Appro, invite a checkpoint host for each checkpoints.

items.question: How do scores work in an Appro?
items.answer: Checkpoint hosts give scores to participants, and the scores add up on the event leaderboard.

items.question: Can I join appro event in a group?
items.answer: Yes, of course. You can create a group in appro event, and ask your friends to join your group

items.question: Where can I get the app?
items.answer: Bonfiire is on the App Store and Google Play.

items.question: I need help. Who do I contact?
items.answer: Use the "Ask for help" button on this page, or email support@bonfiire.io.
